financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Gross proceeds received at closing of the business combination: trust funds net of redemptions ($84.5M), part of the PIPE ($50.6M) and a Bayer convertible note ($5.2M). Net proceeds not given, so gross is used. The date is the 8-K filing date, since the closing date is not stated.
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Combined Company received gross proceeds of approximately $140.3 million of the expected $156.5 million in connection with the Business Combination
